title: Oriande
subtitle: Map of the Strange Lands
tagline: In search of the lost Great City
landmark.ruines.name: Ruins of {n}
landmark.ruines.text: Columns nobody raised — nobody from around here, at least.
landmark.squelette.name: Skeleton of the Leviathan of {n}
landmark.squelette.text: A spine three hundred paces long, bleached, stranded far from any sea.
landmark.champignons.name: Mushroom Forest of {n}
landmark.champignons.text: Caps as tall as steeples. Their dust brings dreams.
landmark.cratere.name: Crater of {n}
landmark.cratere.text: The ground is warm here, and the compass goes mad.
landmark.tour.name: Tower of {n}
landmark.tour.text: No door, no window. At night, one hears a mechanism.
landmark.geyser.name: Geysers of {n}
landmark.geyser.text: The water spurts lukewarm and smells of iron. Birds keep away.
landmark.epave.name: Wreck of the “{n}”
landmark.epave.text: A paddle steamer, keel up. The logbook can still be read.
landmark.tourbillon.name: Maelstrom of {n}
landmark.tourbillon.text: Here the sea turns upon itself, slowly, as it always has.
shore.title: The shore
shore.text: The water is too deep to go on foot. One would need a boat, or something better still.
town.city.title: The city of {n}
town.city.text: Ramparts, a market, a steeple. Supplies can be found here.
town.village.text: A village. They speak a tongue that sounds like singing.
ui.map: Topographic map of a strange world. Tap a spot, then “Walk to” to go there.
wonder.heading: Wonder
wonder.tete.name: Colossal Head of {n}
wonder.tete.text: A stone face as big as a hill, sunk in the earth up to its lips. Its eyes are closed. The Oriandais carved it — or put it to sleep.
wonder.rocher.name: Hanging Rock of {n}
wonder.rocher.text: A block of mountain floats above the valley, with no chain and no pillar. A small temple stands on its top, and a waterfall pours from its edge without ever touching the ground.
wonder.cristal.name: Crystal Forest of {n}
wonder.cristal.text: Prisms taller than trees rise from the earth. They sing when the wind passes — one note, always the same; the note of a bell of Oriande, the old folk say.
wonder.titan.name: Petrified Titan of {n}
wonder.titan.text: A giant lying on its back, turned to stone, one arm raised to the sky as if to hold back something falling. Grass has grown on its chest.
wonder.arches.name: Drowned Arches of {n}
wonder.arches.text: Arcades rise from the water, lined up like the streets of a town. Beneath the surface, stairs can be seen going further down. An Oriandais city sleeps below.
wonder.arbre.name: Light-Tree of {n}
wonder.arbre.text: An immense tree whose leaves shine by themselves, by day and by night. Beasts sleep at its foot without fighting. It is said to have been planted the day Oriande was lost.
walk.foot: as far as the foot of the mountains
landmark.menhirs.name: Stone Circle of {n}
landmark.menhirs.text: The stones face a point in the sky that is no longer there.
landmark.dolmen.name: Dolmen of {n}
landmark.dolmen.text: Under the stone table, scratch marks. They are recent.
landmark.obelisque.name: Obelisk of {n}
landmark.obelisque.text: A single line of writing runs round it, with no beginning and no end.
landmark.puits.name: Bottomless Well of {n}
landmark.puits.text: A dropped stone makes no sound. An hour later, you hear water.
landmark.foretpetrifiee.name: Petrified Forest of {n}
landmark.foretpetrifiee.text: Trees of stone. Their rings tell of summers hotter than ours.
landmark.meteorite.name: Fallen Star of {n}
landmark.meteorite.text: Black, warm, and heavier than it should be. The compass obeys it.
landmark.dirigeable.name: Wreck of the Airship “{n}”
landmark.dirigeable.text: The logbook stops mid-sentence: “We have seen it, it shines…”
landmark.observatoire.name: Observatory of {n}
landmark.observatoire.text: The telescope points at a star our sky charts do not know.
landmark.pontbrise.name: Broken Bridge of {n}
landmark.pontbrise.text: A bridge over nothing. It joined the banks of a river long gone.
landmark.escalier.name: Stair of {n}
landmark.escalier.text: Three hundred steps that climb and stop in thin air. The Oriandais went further.
landmark.porte.name: Gate of {n}
landmark.porte.text: A lone door in the middle of a field. It is locked from the other side.
landmark.labyrinthe.name: Labyrinth of {n}
landmark.labyrinthe.text: At its heart, a carved slab: the plan of a city. Perhaps the right one.
landmark.stele.name: Stele of {n}
landmark.stele.text: The writing of the Oriandais. Three times, the same sign: a star within a circle.
landmark.ermitage.name: Hermitage of {n}
landmark.ermitage.text: The fire is still warm. On the table, an unfinished map.
landmark.mine.name: Abandoned Mine of {n}
landmark.mine.text: The miners left in a hurry. At the end of the gallery they had found a polished wall.
landmark.automate.name: Automaton of {n}
landmark.automate.text: A giant of brass and gears. Wind the key, and its eye lights up for a moment.
landmark.cloche.name: Bell of {n}
landmark.cloche.text: A bell taller than a house. In a strong wind it rings by itself.
landmark.oasis.name: Oasis of {n}
landmark.oasis.text: Clear water, palm trees, and a column the sand never managed to swallow.
landmark.ziggourat.name: Ziggurat of {n}
landmark.ziggourat.text: The jungle has nearly taken it back. At the top, the altar faces north.
landmark.idole.name: Idol of {n}
landmark.idole.text: Its stone eyes follow whoever passes. The monkeys keep away.
landmark.cimetiere.name: Elephants’ Graveyard of {n}
landmark.cimetiere.text: They have always come here to die. Nobody knows why here.
landmark.termitiere.name: Termite Cathedral of {n}
landmark.termitiere.text: Spires of red earth taller than a steeple, built in the likeness of something.
landmark.navireglace.name: Ship Caught in the Ice
landmark.navireglace.text: The crew set off north on foot. Their tracks stop dead.
landmark.mammouth.name: Mammoth of {n}
landmark.mammouth.text: Held in the ice for ten thousand years. In its trunk, a fresh flower.
landmark.clocher.name: Drowned Belfry of {n}
landmark.clocher.text: A whole village sleeps beneath the water. On calm nights, the hours still ring.
landmark.tortue.name: Turtle Isle of {n}
landmark.tortue.text: The island has moved since the last chart. Sailors say it breathes.
landmark.phare.name: Dark Lighthouse of {n}
landmark.phare.text: Nobody lights it any more. And yet, some nights, it shines.
monument.heading: Monument
monument.colosse.name: Colossus of {n}
monument.colosse.text: It held a spear pointed at the horizon. The Oriandais showed the way to those who would come.
monument.pyramide.name: Great Pyramid of {n}
monument.pyramide.text: Its faces are turned to four stars. The door is sealed from the inside.
monument.temple.name: Temple of {n}
monument.temple.text: On the pediment, a procession walks towards a city of light. Its end cannot be seen.
monument.sphinx.name: Sphinx of {n}
monument.sphinx.text: It has always gazed east. They say it is waiting for an answer.
monument.sanctuaire.name: Sanctuary of {n}
monument.sanctuaire.text: Lotus-bud towers in the jungle’s embrace. The air inside is cool as in a church.
monument.arc.name: Arch of {n}
monument.arc.text: It celebrates a homecoming. The inscription reads: “We have come back to Oriande.”
monument.amphitheatre.name: Amphitheatre of {n}
monument.amphitheatre.text: Ten thousand seats. Whisper in the middle of the arena and the last row hears you.
monument.aqueduc.name: Aqueduct of {n}
monument.aqueduc.text: It brought water from the mountains to a city found on no map.
item.remede.name: Phial of remedy
item.biscuit.name: Ship’s biscuit
fight.charge.title: Attack · {a}
fight.charge.text: It charges. Stand your ground, or run far from its territory.
fight.killed.text: You put meat in your pack ({n}).
fight.wake.title: Waking up
fight.wake.text: Local folk brought you back to shelter. Your head is heavy, and you are {n} crowns lighter.
pack.title: Your pack · ♥ {hp}/{max}
item.viande.name: Raw meat
item.poisson.name: Raw fish
item.bois.name: Wood
item.pierre.name: Stones
item.fibre.name: Fibres
item.baton.name: Staff
item.torche.name: Torch
item.canne.name: Fishing rod
item.lance.name: Flint spear
item.torche.text: Lights the night: you see much farther.
item.canne.text: For fishing: tap the water where fish leap.
item.lance.text: The best weapon you can make yourself.
work.needRod.text: Gather wood and fibres, then make one from the pack.
work.tooFar.text: The explorer could not get close enough.
town.sleep.sub: a warm night: all your life comes back
town.slept.text: You set off rested, your life full again.
town.nothingToSell: Nothing to sell: hunt, fish, gather.
item.coutelas.name: Cutlass
item.sabre.name: Sabre
item.coutelas.text: A short, heavy blade, forged in town.
item.sabre.text: An officer’s sabre: the best weapon in the land.
rumor.tower: “A tower without a door, taller than our steeples. Nobody ever knew who built it.”
rumor.leviathan: “On the coast, the bones of a beast longer than a ship. The old ones say it guarded a city.”
rumor.songs: “Our songs tell of Oriande, the city where no one died. My grandmother believed it.”
rumor.maps: “The old maps all stop at the same place, as if someone wished to hide what lay beyond.”
rumor.south: “The caravans from the south bring back cut stones no mason here could make.”
rumor.bells: “Some evenings, when the wind turns, you hear bells where there is no village.”
rumor.stones: “The Oriandans wrote on stone with light. So the pastor said, before he left.”
rumor.traveller: “A traveller came through last winter, looking for Oriande too. He was never seen again.”
rumor.ice: “Beyond the pack ice, the whalers say, the sea is warm. Nobody believes them.”
rumor.river: “Follow a river up to its spring and you will always find a carved stone. Always.”
rumor.night: “Do not walk at night without a torch. Wolves, fair enough. But there is worse.”
rumor.name: “Oriande? My father said it is not the name of a city. It is the name of those who lived there.”
town.smith.done: You already have the best he forges.
item.viande_cuite.name: Roast meat
item.poisson_cuit.name: Grilled fish
item.baies.name: Berries
item.champignon.name: Mushrooms
item.champignon_grille.name: Grilled mushrooms
item.herbes.name: Healing herbs
item.peau.name: Hides
item.os.name: Bones
item.hachette.name: Hatchet
item.pioche.name: Pick
item.couteau.name: Flint knife
item.hamecon.name: Bone hook
item.veste.name: Leather jacket
item.feu.name: Campfire
item.couteau.text: More fibres; when hunting, more meat, the hide and a bone.
item.veste.text: Every blow taken does one point less.
item.feu.text: Laid where you stand, it burns a quarter of an hour: cook, sleep, keep beasts away.
pack.sleep.sub: all your life comes back · costs {n} of belly
pack.sleep.no: you must be hurt and have food in your belly
hunger.title: You are hungry
hunger.text: On an empty belly, life no longer comes back. Hunt, fish, forage, and eat.
hunger.fainted.title: Fainted from hunger
hunger.fainted.text: You were found by the road and carried to town. You are {n} crowns lighter.
sick.title: A bad belly
sick.text: It was raw. Cooked on a campfire, it would go down better.
fire.title: A campfire
fire.text: It will burn a quarter of an hour. Stay close: cook, sleep, and the beasts keep away.
sac.title: The explorer’s pack
sac.material: Used to make things: see the almanac.
almanac.title: Almanac of recipes
almanac.sub: All that can be made by hand.
item.remede.text: Pounded herbs and berries: restores 8 life.
sac.equipHint: Tap a thing to take it up or put it away.
sac.noGear: Nothing to carry: make a staff, a torch, a jacket…
item.bottes.name: Leather boots

town.flavour.village.0: Smoke rises from the thatched roofs. A dog barks, then falls silent as you come near.
town.flavour.village.1: A handful of houses around a well. An old woman nods to you.
town.flavour.village.2: Children run between the haystacks. It smells of warm bread.
town.flavour.village.3: Someone mends a roof, singing. The songs here sound like a forgotten tongue.
town.flavour.village.4: The village is quiet. A cracked bell rings an hour that is not the right one.
town.flavour.city.0: Ramparts, steeples, carts rattling on the cobbles. Posters speak of expeditions.
town.flavour.city.1: The market spills into the streets. Ten tongues are spoken, everything is sold.
town.flavour.city.2: A city of grey stone. In the square, a statue whose name nobody remembers.
town.flavour.city.3: Chimneys smoke, the forge rings. A crier calls out the news of the day.
town.flavour.city.4: At the gates, a guard looks you over, then lets you through with a shrug.
town.line.inn: A bed, a fire: {p} a night.
town.line.shop: Food, and he buys what you gather.
town.say.smith: “These blades don’t break like flint. But they cost.”
town.say.tavern: An old sailor, leaning on the bar, bends towards you:
town.say.inn-village: “There’s fresh straw upstairs, and the soup’s hot. It’s no castle, but you’ll sleep well.”
town.say.inn-city: “Welcome, sir. A room over the square, clean sheets and hot water in the morning.”
town.say.shop-village: “What I’ve got is on the cart. And your hides, I’ll take ’em, if they’re not too moth-eaten.”
town.say.shop-city: “Travel provisions, remedies, fishing and lighting goods. I also buy game, at a fair price.”
